caption: ActionAudit separates the fixed prediction and linked-outcome target from the hospital-boundary process that determines which outcomes enter a restricted audit.
Calibration measured only among hospital-observed outcomes was substantially worse than calibration measured against the linked complete-outcome target in both datasets.
Localized analysis identified strata or discharge actions with smaller robustness margins than the common global perturbation.
Changing only the emulated observation policy altered the restricted calibration estimate while predictions and linked outcomes remained fixed.
In MIMIC-IV, aggressive-policy recalibration improved the restricted target while harming the linked target. SUPPORT2 did not reproduce that pattern.
